subject: Schedule Change Notification - $module_code: Instructor Updated
body:
Dear $recipient_name,

This email is to inform you that there has been a change to the instructor for $module_code - $module_name.

=== Schedule Change Details ===

Change Type: Instructor Change

Schedule Information:
- Day: $day_of_week
- Time: $start_time - $end_time
- Room: $room_location
- Session Type: $session_type

Previous Instructor: $old_instructor_name
New Instructor: $new_instructor_name
Instructor Email: $new_instructor_email

=== Action Required ===

Please note the change in instructor for this module. The new instructor will be responsible for teaching this session going forward.

=== Contact Information ===

For questions about the module content or schedule:
- New Instructor: $new_instructor_email
- Module Coordinator: $coordinator_email
- Academic Office: academic.office@university.edu

Thank you for your understanding.

$signature
